artist.name: D_MAK
artist.signature: Every heart runs on a frequency.
artist.positioning: D_MAK is a Ugandan recording artist turning Luganda love songs into widescreen, after-midnight pop — made in Busia, built for the whole internet.
artist.shortBio: Wandera David Musamya — D_MAK — is a Ugandan recording artist from Busia who started writing songs in school in 2016 and never put the pen down. Since 2022 he has released a steady run of Luganda love records — Nkulina, Ogonda Nnyo, Bitandike, Ffe Tuliko, Naawe — melodies built for headphones at 2AM and for the crowded taxi home.
artist.cinematicIntro: A room in Busia. A phone torch, a borrowed beat, a hook hummed until the neighbours know it by heart. Ten years later the same voice is cutting through speakers in Kampala — a little deeper, a lot more certain — still singing in Luganda about the one person who makes the long road worth it.
artist.philosophy: A song is not finished when it is mixed. It is finished when somebody in another language knows exactly what it means. I write Luganda records for that moment — when a hook crosses the border without needing a translation.
artist.vision: To build a catalogue that travels: Luganda melodies in global playlists, Ugandan storytelling in cinematic visuals, and a fan community that treats the artist like a frequency they discovered first.

careerHighlights.title: First recordings
careerHighlights.text: Starts writing and recording while still in school, developing a Luganda songwriting voice.

careerHighlights.title: Tubikole & Nkulina
careerHighlights.text: Two singles land on streaming and social, establishing the name with local listeners.

careerHighlights.title: Nkulina official video
careerHighlights.text: The Nkulina video premieres on 9 February 2023 through Yuut Empire and passes 11,300 views — the biggest visual statement of his catalogue to date.

careerHighlights.title: Ogonda Nnyo
careerHighlights.text: Released 6 April 2023; the record becomes the most-used D_MAK sound on his TikTok, carried by user clips and dance videos.

careerHighlights.title: Three releases in one year
careerHighlights.text: Bitandike (February), Ffe Tuliko (May) and the Sera Biebe duet Only You (August) arrive inside eight months.

careerHighlights.title: Independent era
careerHighlights.text: Wadala, Bwotyo and Naawe are released under his own imprint names Davmak city and Silence town, with Melo Killit and Silence producing.

releases.title: Naawe
releases.label: Silence town
releases.summary: The newest chapter: a gold-lit devotion record that trades speed for sincerity.
releases.story: Naawe — 'with you' — is D_MAK at his most direct. Produced by Melo Killit and Silence, it is a two-minute promise rather than a three-minute performance, and it sets the tone for the next body of work.

releases.title: Bwotyo
releases.label: Davmak city
releases.summary: A warm, close-mic'd groove about loving somebody exactly as they are.
releases.story: Bwotyo — 'that's how it is' — is the shrug that turns into a hook. Released under his own Davmak city imprint.

releases.title: Wadala (Cruise on Dance Version)
releases.label: Davmak city
releases.summary: The dance-floor edit: same song, wider shoulders, more room to move.
releases.story: A re-cut of Wadala built for the cruise — the version that earns its place in a DJ set rather than a headphones session.

releases.title: Only You
releases.label: Yuut Empire
releases.summary: The duet. D_MAK and Sera Biebe trading lines over a slow-burning, rose-lit production.
releases.story: Only You is the collaboration that widened the room: two voices, one argument about who loves who more, resolved in the chorus.

releases.title: Ffe Tuliko
releases.label: Yuut Empire
releases.summary: Confidence record. 'We are here' — a statement of arrival in two and a half minutes.
releases.story: Ffe Tuliko is the sound of a young artist staking a claim, with the sweetest possible delivery.

releases.title: Bitandike
releases.label: Yuut Empire
releases.summary: Violet-lit and patient: 'let's start' — the most cinematic three minutes in the catalogue.
releases.story: Bitandike opens with air and lets the beat arrive late, giving the vocal the whole frame. The artwork set the visual language the later covers followed.

releases.title: Ogonda Nnyo
releases.label: Yuut Empire
releases.summary: The crimson one. 'You love me so much' — his most-used sound across TikTok, and still the live favourite.
releases.story: Ogonda Nnyo is the record that moved the name from a local playlist to a shared sound. Clips using the song built its second life: dancers, couples, and caption videos carrying the hook further than any single post could.

instagram.setup: Add INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN (a long-lived token for the @d_mak_music account) to your environment. The server then proxies /api/instagram and the Connect page renders a live feed. Until a token exists, the page renders the verified fallback tiles instead of pretending to be live.
instagram.fallbackNote: Live feed off — showing verified static tiles.

youtube.setup: Add YOUTUBE_API_KEY and YOUTUBE_CHANNEL_ID to pull the channel's uploads automatically. Video embeds work without a key; only the automatic channel sync needs one.

previews.mode: Server-side proxy of 30-second Deezer preview clips
previews.note: Previews are fetched fresh on each request from Deezer's public API and streamed through /api/preview/:trackId — no audio is stored on this server. Disable with PREVIEWS=off.

newsletter.note: Set MAILCHIMP_* or BUTTONDOWN_API_KEY in the environment to also forward new subscribers to an email provider.

contact.note: Set SMTP_URL or a transactional provider key to also email enquiries to the booking address.
